commit_message: Align ADR0154 tests with schema v3 routing
pr_title: Implement ADR 0154 target-aware animation motion binding
pr_body:
Continues ADR 0154 first-release completion after the validation fix: removes the deleted pre-ADR0154 packaging-policy test, updates Editor and Scene Bridge tests to schema-v3 candidate-only/shared-planner semantics, makes package preflight tests require MotionBindingFailed when no Native/Retarget/Humanoid route exists, and aligns package documentation with that blocking contract. Existing pre-Play Problems projection and portable provenance fixes remain unchanged.

The PR remains Draft and must not be merged automatically.
